notes_for_editor: The only history is one line in the Eastern US Lookouts listing (1941, CCC, 120 ft, citing the 9th Biennial Report, 1942). No second source gives Clarkton history, so the story is 79 words, below the 120-word floor. Brief status and access are unknown and nothing read settles them; the story says no source describes the site today. The tnlandforms row shows '0 bm' in its survey-mark column; that was not interpreted and is not cited for anything except coordinates. Wikipedia is used only for the town. Two web searches and the cached pages were checked; no news, register or survey record for the Clarkton tower turned up.
